items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: Right, they left the same day.

ctx.x: I have this wonderful moment with him talking with Gerald Wilson and they were talking about going from the Lunceford band —
Right, they left the same day.
And went to the Basie band, and Snooky said, “I had to learn how to play all over.”
